name: Question 4
problem:
A reactor initially holds $520\,\text{L}$ of a chemical solution containing $8\,\text{kg}$ of reactant.
A pure solvent is poured into the reactor at a rate of $16\,\text{L/min},$ while the completely mixed solution leaves the reactor at a rate of $20\,\text{L/min}.$ Which differential equation best describes the amount of reactant $Q,$ in kilograms, in the reactor $t$ minutes after the solvent begins to be added?

Question 4
?

A reactor initially holds 520L of a chemical solution containing 8kg of reactant. A pure solvent is poured into the reactor at a rate of 16L/min, while the completely mixed solution leaves the reactor at a rate of 20L/min. Which differential equation best describes the amount of reactant Q, in kilograms, in the reactor t minutes after the solvent begins to be added?

a
dQdt+5130−tQ=0
b
dQdt−5130−tQ=0
c
dQdt+1130−tQ=0
d
dQdt+4130−tQ=0
e
dQdt−4130−tQ=0
